submissions.decision-distinct-design-rollup-discrepa: WITH audit AS (SELECT r.parent, p.designs AS reported_designs, l.designs + h.designs - r.shared_designs AS implied_designs FROM rollups AS r JOIN reports AS p ON p.node = r.parent JOIN reports AS l ON l.node = r.left_child JOIN reports AS h ON h.node = r.right_child) SELECT parent, reported_designs, implied_designs, reported_designs - implied_designs AS delta_designs FROM audit WHERE reported_designs <> implied_designs ORDER BY parent COLLATE BINARY ASC
submissions.decision-diversion-path-insurance: WITH outcomes AS (SELECT p.package_id, p.premium_cents, b.bulletin_id, a.auth_id, p.premium_cents + MAX(0, b.need_qty - p.path_qty) * b.short_cents AS cost_cents FROM path_package AS p JOIN path_authority AS a ON p.premium_cents <= a.cap_cents CROSS JOIN demand_bulletin AS b), ranked AS (SELECT outcomes.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY package_id ORDER BY cost_cents DESC, bulletin_id COLLATE BINARY ASC) AS outcome_rank FROM outcomes) SELECT package_id, cost_cents AS worst_cents, bulletin_id, auth_id FROM ranked WHERE outcome_rank = 1 ORDER BY cost_cents ASC, premium_cents ASC, package_id COLLATE BINARY ASC LIMIT 1
submissions.decision-double-stage-carton-inspection: SELECT s1.lot_id, CASE WHEN s1.defects <= 1 THEN 'ACCEPT' WHEN s1.defects >= 4 THEN 'REJECT' WHEN s2.stage IS NULL THEN 'AWAIT_STAGE_2' WHEN s1.defects + s2.defects <= 4 THEN 'ACCEPT' ELSE 'REJECT' END AS decision FROM carton_samples AS s1 LEFT JOIN carton_samples AS s2 ON s2.lot_id = s1.lot_id AND s2.stage = 2 WHERE s1.stage = 1 ORDER BY s1.lot_id ASC
submissions.decision-dryer-paired-moisture-change: SELECT line_code, COUNT(inlet_bp - outlet_bp) AS paired_trays, AVG(inlet_bp - outlet_bp) AS mean_drop_bp FROM tray_pass GROUP BY line_code ORDER BY line_code COLLATE BINARY ASC
